title: Window Functions — Ranking & Aggregation
description:
## Window Functions
Window functions calculate values across a set of rows related to the current row - without collapsing them like GROUP BY does.

- `RANK() OVER (ORDER BY col)` - assigns a rank
- `ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY col)` - assigns a row number
- `SUM(col) OVER (ORDER BY col)` - running total

```sql
SELECT title, escalation_level,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY escalation_level DESC) AS priority_rank
FROM tickets;
```
Every row stays - but each gets a rank based on the window.
